def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find block: largest connected mono region of non-bg color
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    best=None
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]
                st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if seen[a][b] or g[a][b]!=c: continue
                    seen[a][b]=True; cells.append((a,b))
                    for da in(-1,0,1):
                        for db in(-1,0,1):
                            x,y=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==c: st.append((x,y))
                if best is None or len(cells)>len(best): best=cells
    bc=g[best[0][0]][best[0][1]]
    br=[r for r,_ in best]; bb=[c for _,c in best]
    top,bot=min(br),max(br); left,right=min(bb),max(bb)
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=bc and (i,j) not in best:
                c=g[i][j]
                # direction toward block: choose axis with smaller gap
                di=i-top if i<top else (bot-i if i>bot else 0)
                dj=j-left if j<left else (right-j if j>right else 0)
                if di==0 and dj==0: continue
                cand=[]
                if di<=dj:
                    # vertical ray
                    s,d=(min(i,top),1) if i<top else (max(i,bot),-1)
                    p=s
                    while 0<=p<top or (top<p<=i or bot>p<=i):
                        p+=d
                        if top<p<bot and left<=p<=right: pass
                        if not (top<=p<=bot and left<=p<=right): continue
                        res[p][j]=c; break
                else:
                    s,d=(min(j,left),1) if j<left else (max(j,right),-1)
                    p=s
                    while True:
                        p+=d
                        if not (top<=p<=bot and left<=p<=right): continue
                        res[i][p]=c; break
    return res
